Job Title: Financial Advisor
Company: AIA (Cambodia) Life Insurance Plc (Agency)
Location: Battambang
Employment Type: Full Time

Job Summary
Financial Advisor at AIA Cambodia. Build trusted client relationships, assess financial needs, and present suitable insurance solutions that help customers protect their future and achieve long-term goals.
Key Responsibilities
• Identify and approach prospective clients through networking, referrals, and market activities.
• Conduct client consultations to understand needs, financial goals, and protection priorities.
• Recommend suitable AIA products and solutions with clear, ethical, and accurate guidance.
• Follow up with prospects and existing clients to support policy sales and retention.
• Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets while maintaining high service quality.
• Prepare sales reports, update client records, and coordinate with internal teams as needed.
• Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, marketing, or a related field preferred.
• Experience in sales, customer service, or financial advisory is an advantage.
• Strong communication, persuasion, and relationship-building skills.
• Self-motivated, target-driven, and able to work independently.
• Good understanding of insurance or financial products is a plus.
• Proficiency in English and Khmer; additional languages are an advantage.
• Professional appearance and a customer-focused attitude.
• Attractive income package from USD 6,000+ per annually
• Overseas Travel
• International Recognition Awards
• Bonus up to 15 months
